topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Oh wow, so I get home, and there's this package waiting for me. It's not just any package, it's got a name on it, and guess what? It’s not mine! I’m staring at it, thinking, "What in the world?" Turns out, it's for the person who lived here before me. Can you believe it? I mean, the address is right, the apartment number, everything, but the name is all wrong. I don't even know this person. What do I do now? Should I try to track them down or just let it sit there? This is so weird, but kind of exciting, you know? I'm gonna have to figure this one out.
